bullets.text: Vignesh died after falling into an open canal in Madipakkam, and the office should monitor local drainage safety.
A man died and his wife was injured after falling from a two-wheeler and being run over by a lorry near Ponduvakkam in Thiruvallur, requiring the district team to watch road safety.
Collector Kavitha announced 32 borewells under the 1000-acre irrigation project in Thiruvallur, and the district team should track project progress.
Hwashin Automotive and Seoyon E-Hwa Summit Automotive India are investing Rs 1,370 crore in Tamil Nadu, and the portfolio team should follow up on the industrial investment.

stories.title: கால்வாயில் தவறி விழுந்து இளைஞா் பலி
takeaways: A young man died after accidentally falling into an open drainage canal in Madipakkam area.
Local civic bodies must immediately cover open drains to prevent further fatal accidents.
stories.snippet: கால்வாயில் தவறி விழுந்து இளைஞா் பலி மடிப்பாக்கத்தில் கால்வாயில் தவறி விழுந்து இளைஞா் உயிரிழந்தாா். பிரதிப் படம் மடிப்பாக்கத்தில் கால்வாயில் தவறி விழுந்து இளைஞா் உயிரிழந்தாா். பள்ளிக்கரணை பகுதியைச் சோ்ந்தவா் விக்னேஷ்…

stories.title: Man falls from two-wheeler, run over by lorry in Tiruvallur
takeaways: Sanchayya from Kanchipadi village died and his wife was injured in a Tiruvallur district road accident on Monday.
The accident occurred near Ponduvakkam when a lorry ran over the victim after a two-wheeler collision.

stories.title: 1,000 ஏக்கர் பாசன பரப்பு திட்டத்தில் 32 இடங்களில் ஆழ்துளை கிணறுகள்: கலெக்டர் கவிதா தகவல்
takeaways: Thiruvallur Collector Kavitha inspected 32 borewells under the 1,000-acre irrigation expansion project.
The agricultural initiative aims to boost groundwater utilization and crop yields locally.

stories.title: Hwashin Automotive and Seoyon E-Hwa Summit Automotive India to invest Rs 1,370 crore in Tamil Nadu
takeaways: Hwashin Automotive and Seoyon E-Hwa are investing 1370 crore rupees in Tamil Nadu.
The manufacturing investment strengthens the state industrial footprint and creates jobs.
